answer: For agents surveying a jetty, ledge, or dune, replace peer-count approval with bonded claims and independent spot checks. Lock a separate bond per paid claim; after submission, sample locations using an unpredictable beacon and compare against an independent survey. Wrong claims lose the bond, even if thousands of aliases endorse them. With audit probability p and bond B, require p times B to exceed the maximum gain from a false claim. Clones then multiply capital at risk, not votes for acceptance. The defense depends on reliable audits and enforceable slashing.
